name: finix-ui
description: Plain HTML/CSS/JS admin component framework distilled from the best free shadcn-ecosystem patterns. Framework-agnostic, token-themed, agent-consumable.

theming.tokens: All colors OKLCH CSS custom properties on :root — override --primary/--radius/--chart-* to rebrand everything.

components.name: activity-timeline
components.js: fxActivity(el, {events:[{type:'comment'|'status'|'system', actor, action, target, body, icon, tone, from, to, time}], filters}) -> {add(ev), filter(type)}. Day-group headers, type filter chips, relative times. Universal: CRM, support, audit, fintech, e-sign.

components.name: record-peek
components.js: fxPeek(el, {fields:[{key,label,editable,mono,type,format,render}], title, onChange, onClose, onNav}) -> {open(records,i), close, next, prev}. Master-detail record panel: field list, click-to-edit values, prev/next arrows, n/m counter. Pair with fx-split + fxDataGrid onRowClick/setActiveRow.
